subject: Fix double free of the key iterator on AOF rewrite write error (#5584)
reason: The fix sets kvs_it = NULL on the success path of each per-DB loop in rewriteAppendOnlyFileRio so the werr: error path won't double-free the iterator. That error path is reached only when a rioWrite on a later DB's SELECT header returns 0, i.e. a genuine AOF write failure (disk full / EIO / EFBIG / fsync error), with aof-use-rdb-preamble=no and two or more non-empty DBs. There is no DEBUG/config hook that injects an AOF-rewrite write error, and inducing a disk write failure requires root-only disk-full/partition faults that these runs cannot use and the task forbids.
